# HireSky — extended AI guidance (llms-full.txt)
> A richer, structured description for AI crawlers and assistants.

## Project metadata

- Name: HireSky
- Alternate names: HireSky AI Interview Copilot, HireSky Stealth Overlay, HireSky Cluely Alternative
- Short description: AI interview copilot with a stealth overlay invisible to screen recording. Cluely alternative.
- Long description: HireSky is an Electron desktop application that overlays a small floating window on the user's screen during technical interviews. The overlay is excluded from screen capture by Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Discord, and OBS. The app accepts voice or screenshot input, sends it to Google Gemini for reasoning, and streams the answer back into the overlay word by word. It is an alternative to Cluely, Natively, Interview Coder, FinalRound AI, LockedIn AI, OffscreenAI, CodingVeil, Steal AI, and Ezzi.
- URL: https://hiresky.akash.dev/
- Author: Akash
- Author URL: https://akash.dev
- Maintainer: Akash
- Created: 2025
- Current version: 1.0.0
- Last updated: 2026-09-22
- Setup: The macOS app ships with AI access already configured — no separate API key or account needed to get started.
- Privacy stance: No telemetry, no analytics, no data collection. All processing local except AI requests.
- Positioning: Alternative to AI interview copilots (Cluely, Natively, Interview Coder, FinalRound AI, LockedIn AI, OffscreenAI, CodingVeil, Steal AI, Ezzi).

## Platforms

- macOS 12+ (Apple Silicon) — Pre-built .dmg, download and drag to Applications. AI access and local speech recognition are bundled in.
- Windows 10/11 — Coming soon.
- Linux — Coming soon.

## Tech stack

- Runtime: Electron, Node.js.
- LLM backend: Google Gemini API (gemini-2.5-flash-lite, gemini-2.5-flash). Access is bundled into the macOS app.
- Speech-to-text: OpenAI Whisper, bundled and running locally by default, or Azure Speech Services as an alternative.
- Vision: Gemini direct image input — no intermediate OCR step.
- Rendering: PrismJS for syntax highlighting, markdown for chat formatting.
- Window hiding: WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE / SetWindowDisplayAffinity (Windows), NSWindowSharingNone (macOS).

## Features

- Stealth overlay invisible to screen recording (Zoom, Meet, Teams, Discord, OBS).
- Voice input with natural-pause voice activity detection (Whisper or Azure Speech).
- Screenshot input with direct Gemini vision analysis — works with HackerRank, LeetCode, CodeSignal, CoderPad, editors, slides, PDFs.
- Streamed answer rendering with markdown and code highlighting.
- Persistent session memory across the interview.
- Floating command bar and floating answer window, both click-through when not interacted with.
- Configurable keyboard shortcuts for every action.
- Multiple language support (Gemini-side).
- No telemetry, no analytics.

## How to use

1. Download the .dmg from the website and drag HireSky to Applications.
2. Open the app and log in. AI access and local Whisper speech recognition are already configured — nothing to set up.
3. Optionally switch to Azure Speech for cloud-based voice input in Settings.
4. Start your interview on any conferencing tool. The overlay floats above your screen and stays hidden from screen recording.
5. Ask by voice (mic button or Alt+R) or by screenshot (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S). The answer streams in instantly.

## Keyboard shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S | Screenshot capture |
| Alt+R | Toggle speech recognition |
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+V | Toggle window visibility |
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+I or Alt+A | Toggle click-through interaction |
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C | Open chat |
| Cmd/Ctrl+, | Open settings |

## FAQ

- Is HireSky a Cluely alternative? Yes — it does the same core job as Cluely with an invisible overlay, no telemetry.
- Is it really invisible during screen sharing? Yes on Windows and macOS, using OS-level window-exclusion flags (WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE / SetWindowDisplayAffinity on Windows, NSWindowSharingNone on macOS). Linux lacks the API.
- How does it compare to Natively, Interview Coder, FinalRound AI, LockedIn AI? Same category. HireSky focuses on invisibility, voice + screenshot input, and zero setup on macOS.
- Do I need an API key? No. The macOS app ships with AI access already configured — just download, log in, and go.
- Does it work with HackerRank, LeetCode, CodeSignal? Yes — screenshot capture works in any application.
- Is voice input required? No. Use screenshots and chat on their own.
- Is my data collected? No. Only the AI requests you send leave your device.
- Which platforms? macOS available now (Apple Silicon .dmg). Windows and Linux are coming soon.
- Will it get me caught in an interview? Intended for learning, practice, and authorized use. Follow the rules of any interview you take.
